Name: Seasonal Town Lamp Posts
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EoRciNf.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]Hello! This is my first DGA mod (Now Content Patcher), and I was tired of the small lamp posts (Why do NPCs get the tall ones?) So I'm very happy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11906]Tall Lamp Posts[/url] exists. I wanted to make a version without split parts. Now Robin sells town lamp posts. You can buy one for 1000 gold. I hope that is a good price?[/size]
